audit_items.proof_trace: The inherited `supplyTokens` calls `_verifyCanSupplyTokens(amount)` (L846-857) which reverts with `LegionSale__TokensNotAllocated` if `s_saleStatus.totalTokensAllocated == 0`. In the OpenApp contract the only setter for `totalTokensAllocated` is `publishSaleResults` (LegionPreLiquidOpenApplicationSale.sol:L152). Therefore `supplyTokens` cannot succeed before `publishSaleResults` has been called with a non-zero allocation — the property holds.
